rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-accredited CE or CE pre-approved by the Board
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: registered one full calendar year → 3 hours (at least 1 live); registered less than one full calendar year → no CE.
rules.audit_note: Random Board audits; keep CE records 2 years and send them within 30 days of a Board request.
rules.notes: At least 2 of the 6 hours must be live (in-person or live virtual, not pre-recorded). Registrations expire December 31 of odd-numbered years; renewal window Oct 1–Dec 31; all CE must be done by 12/31.
